penguin.reviewed_by: Codex: direct full native view/motion sheets, icons, equal-scale anatomy comparisons, final world images and explicit orientation/stance review; not user sign-off
penguin.notes: Twelve functional joints, familiar upright dark back/pale chest, gold feet/beak and short flippers. Own pixels and authored land waddle plus horizontal swim with counter-rotated head. The legacy fly clip name remains mapped to Swim; can_fly stays false. Separate eight-phase native Swim sheet inspected; actual water world frame shows upright Tread/idle loading, not a claim of an observed continuous swimming route. Gameplay bounds, speeds and habitat unchanged. Authored forward axis is now required; tests check facing and stance direction, not just absence of sinking. Performance gates disabled; not a performance pass. Final normal bin/models Release launch, without asset-root override, inspected. All 29 native frames per species are pixel-identical to reviewed QA frames; production_preview_parity.json and context_production_release.json record evidence after icon cache v3 update.

owl.reviewed_by: Codex: direct full native view/motion sheets, icons, equal-scale anatomy comparisons, final world images and explicit orientation/stance review; not user sign-off
owl.notes: Fourteen functional joints, tall perched silhouette, facial discs, hooked beak, ear tufts and separate talons. Two-segment weighted wings have separate fly and glide clips with explicit runtime state mappings. The original idle/walk capabilities are retained. Native full-cycle fly and glide inspected without cropped wingtips; original collider bounds were insufficient for preview camera fitting. Gameplay bounds, speeds and habitat unchanged. Authored forward axis is now required; tests check facing and stance direction, not just absence of sinking. Performance gates disabled; not a performance pass. Final normal bin/models Release launch, without asset-root override, inspected. All 29 native frames per species are pixel-identical to reviewed QA frames; production_preview_parity.json and context_production_release.json record evidence after icon cache v3 update.

production_validation: Penguin/owl only; 58/58 pixel-identical frames, ordinary bin/models, no QA asset-root override. This does not complete global R6.
